$schema-note: Hand-rolled strict subset (no jsonschema dependency, per DEPENDENCY RULES). Validated by tools/xr_schema.py. additionalProperties is false everywhere. LAWS: `context` carries ONLY origin (scheme + registrable domain — no path, no query, no fragment), a UA-LESS browser version tag, the matched rule/list ids and the list's bundle version; page content, cookies, full URLs and user agents are absent BY SCHEMA, so a report that tries to carry them is refused before it is written, not scrubbed after. `queue` is const "fixture": this contract has no live mode in this repository, and a payload that claims otherwise cannot be validated. `sla` is DATA (label + hours + class), never a rendered sentence, so no tool can assert a median it did not measure. `created_at` is caller-supplied (`--as-of`): the generator contains no clock.
